journeyDialog.startBody: The patient will be told you're on the way and can follow your live location until you arrive.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this visit?
cancelDialog.bodyPaid: The patient will get a full refund to their wallet. Only cancel if it's an emergency.
cancelDialog.bodyUnpaid: The patient will be told you can't make it. Only cancel if it's an emergency.

vitals.criticalAdvice: Recheck once. If it stays like this, contact the patient's doctor now. Chest pain, breathing difficulty, fainting or confusion → call 108 immediately.

vitals.familyAlerted: The patient's family has been alerted.
vitals.warningNote: Mention it in your visit notes.

APPROVED.body: Patients near you can book the services you offer.

REJECTED.body: Please check your details and documents, or contact support.
